name: CM-01 Creator Match: brief to shortlist

parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake
Form (or PDF brief) → Claude turns it into **criteria JSON** with structured outputs → validate.
Missing fields? Ask the requester in Slack instead of guessing.
**Fallback:** if Claude errors after 3 tries, the error output calls OpenAI.

## 2 · Retrieve & score
BigQuery applies the **hard rules** (consent, blocked, 90-day competitor work).
Code scores performance (Bayesian-shrunk history + engagement vs tier), audience fit and cost. Stale profiles refresh via CM-02.

## 3 · Judge (LLM)
Claude rates brand fit per creator: score, cited rationale, risk flags. Batches of 5, 1 s apart. A failed call becomes **"not assessed"**; it never blocks the shortlist.

## 4 · Deliver & learn
Weighted rank by objective + diversity rule → shortlist Sheet → **Slack approval** (restricted approvers). Approved picks feed Proposal Copilot; every decision and override is logged as feedback.

### Reliability on every API node
Retry 3x, 5 s apart · timeout 60 s (LLM) · error output or "not assessed" path · Error workflow = **OPS-01** (Slack #ai-ops alert + dead-letter table + backoff retries).
_Demo: data is pinned, so "Test workflow" runs without credentials._

parameters.formDescription: Your shortlist arrives in Slack in about 5 minutes.

parameters.sqlQuery:
-- GoogleSQL. Hard rules run here, before any AI.
DECLARE criteria JSON DEFAULT PARSE_JSON(@criteria_json);
SELECT c.creator_id, c.handle, c.platform, c.tier, m.followers,
       a.audience_fit, m.er, b.er_tier_median,
       p.campaigns_count, p.perf_vs_benchmark, c.est_rate_thb,
       DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), m.snapshot_date, DAY) AS data_age_days,
       c.brand_safety_status, t.recent_captions, t.content_tags, p.past_brands, t.comment_sentiment
FROM marts.dim_creator c
JOIN marts.creator_metrics_latest m USING (creator_id)
JOIN marts.creator_audience_fit a USING (creator_id)
JOIN marts.tier_benchmarks b ON b.platform = c.platform AND b.tier = c.tier
LEFT JOIN marts.creator_performance p USING (creator_id)
LEFT JOIN marts.creator_content_tags t USING (creator_id)
WHERE c.platform IN UNNEST(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY(criteria.platforms))
  AND c.consent_status != 'revoked'
  AND c.brand_safety_status != 'blocked'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marts.creator_brand_history h
                  WHERE h.creator_id = c.creator_id AND h.is_competitor_of = @brand
                    AND h.posted_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY))
ORDER BY a.audience_fit DESC
LIMIT 60

parameters.jsCode:
// One row per creator for the shortlist Sheet; Decision and Reason are filled in by the strategist
const sheetId = $('Drive: copy shortlist template').first().json.id;
return $('Rank + hard rules').all().map(({ json: c }) => ({ json: {
  sheet_id: sheetId,
  Rank: c.rank,
  Pick: c.pick,
  Creator: c.handle,
  Platform: c.platform,
  Tier: c.tier,
  'Match score': c.match_score,
  Performance: Math.round(c.perf_score),
  'Audience fit': Math.round(c.audience_score),
  'Brand fit': c.brand_fit ?? 'not assessed',
  'Cost efficiency': Math.round(c.cost_score),
  Why: c.rationale,
  'Risk flags': (c.risk_flags || []).join(', ') || 'none',
  'Est. rate (THB)': c.est_rate_thb,
  Decision: '',
  Reason: '',
} }));
